sourceFile: 33. BRS-161014 Report TEST VP NG burr, deform 20.9.2023_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Comparable VP burr/deform vs normal function evidence exists, but the draft has material grouping and bogus measurement extraction issues.
issues: Changed domain mislabeled as jig/process instead of VP material defect condition.
Sub 1 outcome lacks normal baseline and should be treated as burr vs deform usability result.
Measurement outcome is a misparsed function header, not valid measurement evidence.
Evidence set omits visible decision row supporting final use judgement.
Judgements remain not_judged despite clear report conclusions.
correctionPlan: Rename changed factor to VP condition: normal vs VP NG burr vs VP NG deform.
Set domain to component/material defect condition.
Keep Sub 1 and function as separate outcomes under the same changed factor.
Remove the measurement outcome and derived stats from row 36.
Add decision/conclusion rows and assign outcome judgements from report conclusions.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations are mostly sufficient, but final evidence must cite actual data rows plus conclusion rows after removing invalid measurement citations.
